apr_hidden_fees.regulatory_anchor: RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (2022/2024) & Key Fact Statement (KFS) Mandate
apr_hidden_fees.audit_verdict: HIGH RISK: Violation of Standardized KFS Requirements
apr_hidden_fees.explanation: Lenders are legally mandated to present a standardized Key Fact Statement (KFS) stating the all-inclusive Annual Percentage Rate (APR) before disbursal. Deducting upfront platform fees, hidden processing charges, or third-party brokerage not disclosed in the KFS is strictly unlawful.
apr_hidden_fees.statutory_remedy: Lenders cannot collect any fees not explicitly itemized in the KFS. File a formal complaint through the lender's Principal Nodal Officer and escalate to the RBI CMS portal (cms.rbi.org.in).

coercive_device_permissions.regulatory_anchor: RBI Digital Lending Norms — Restriction on Mobile Device Data Access
coercive_device_permissions.audit_title: Unlawful Access to Personal Contacts & Phone Storage
coercive_device_permissions.audit_verdict: CRITICAL VIOLATION: Prohibited Data Harvesting Vector
coercive_device_permissions.explanation: RBI directives explicitly prohibit Digital Lending Apps (DLAs) and Lending Service Providers (LSPs) from accessing borrower contact books, media galleries, call records, and local file storage. Access is limited strictly to one-time camera, mic, or location purely for KYC onboarding.
coercive_device_permissions.statutory_remedy: Demand immediate deletion of harvested device telemetry under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and report the application to the cyber cell and RBI enforcement team.

recovery_agent_harassment.regulatory_anchor: RBI Guidelines on Fair Practices Code & Recovery Agent Conduct
recovery_agent_harassment.audit_verdict: CRITICAL VIOLATION: Criminal Intimidation & Harassment Breach
recovery_agent_harassment.explanation: Recovery agents are strictly prohibited from intimidating borrowers, contacting friends or family, visiting homes without prior appointment, calling before 8:00 AM or after 7:00 PM, or threatening arrest. The regulated entity remains directly liable for vendor misconduct.
recovery_agent_harassment.statutory_remedy: Lodge an immediate complaint with the local police station for harassment and file an actionable grievance with the RBI Ombudsman.

cooling_off_cancellation.regulatory_anchor: RBI Mandated Look-up / Cooling-off Period for Digital Loans
cooling_off_cancellation.audit_title: Denial of Statutory Loan Exit Rights
cooling_off_cancellation.explanation: Borrowers have an explicit statutory right to exit a digital loan without paying foreclosure penalties by repaying the principal plus proportionate APR within the look-up period (minimum 3 days for tenures ≥ 7 days; 1 day for shorter tenures).
cooling_off_cancellation.statutory_remedy: Submit written notice to the lender invoking the statutory look-up period under RBI Digital Lending Guidelines and tender the principal plus proportionate APR.

credit_card_unilateral_terms.regulatory_anchor: RBI Master Direction – Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct Directions
credit_card_unilateral_terms.audit_title: Unsolicited Upgrades, Arbitrary Limits & Revolving Traps
credit_card_unilateral_terms.audit_verdict: HIGH RISK: Violation of Credit Card Governance Norms
credit_card_unilateral_terms.explanation: Card issuers are prohibited from unilaterally enhancing credit limits, issuing unsolicited cards, or converting purchases to EMIs without explicit written consent. Requests for card closure must be completed within 7 working days, failing which the issuer incurs statutory penalty fines.
credit_card_unilateral_terms.statutory_remedy: If a card is issued without consent or closure is delayed beyond 7 days, demand compensation of ₹500 per day of delay directly from the bank.

out_of_scope.audit_verdict: ABSTAIN: Query Outside Digital Lending & Consumer Debt Scope
out_of_scope.explanation: ClauseCheck is trained exclusively on Indian consumer credit agreements, RBI digital lending guidelines, and credit card terms. It abstains from general trivia, coding tasks, or generic conversation.
out_of_scope.statutory_remedy: Please submit a question concerning loan contracts, interest rate transparency, recovery agent conduct, device permissions, or credit card fees.
